body:
`run_x86_retire_cohort_gate()`'s pairing-fork test fails with `Fail("pairing fork failed")` when x86 is built with `--features boot_tests` alone (no `testing`, no `external_test_bins`) — reproduced on unmodified `origin/main` at `5c53ba590bbd34dc9f342a8a7bb07763608b6548`, so this predates and is unrelated to #813.

**Reproduction**: build `cargo build --release --features boot_tests --bin qemu-uefi` on x86_64 at that commit, boot the resulting UEFI image with any disk (the failure happens during the kernel's built-in early self-test battery, before disk-based init runs). Serial output:

```
[TEST:process:x86_retire_cohort:START]
[TEST:process:x86_retire_cohort:FAIL:Fail("pairing fork failed")]
KERNEL PANIC: panicked at kernel/src/tracing/providers/teardown.rs:2556:5:
x86 retire cohort gate failed
```

The failing call is `manager.fork_process_with_page_table(parent_pid, None, None, child_page_table)` inside `fork_exit_defer_reclaim_pairing_test()` (`kernel/src/tracing/providers/teardown.rs`), partway through its `for iteration in 0..64` pairing loop.

**Why this was never caught before**: every existing x86 gate builds either `boot_tests,testing,external_test_bins` (`run-x86-boot-tests.sh`) or no features at all (`run-x86-prod-profile-boot-test.sh`). `run_x86_retire_cohort_gate()` runs unconditionally whenever `boot_tests` is on (`kernel/src/main.rs`, unguarded by `testing`/`external_test_bins`), but until #813's `docker/qemu/run-blocking-io-oracle-gate.sh` — which the #813 plan explicitly specifies must build a `boot_tests`-only x86 profile, distinct from the `testing` loader profile — nothing had ever booted x86 with `boot_tests` alone. This looks like an environment-dependent resource assumption (frame/PID budget, or something the `testing`/`external_test_bins` build's larger footprint happens to leave in a different state) that this exact feature combination newly exposes, not a logic bug introduced by any recent change.

**Impact on #813**: PR-A's `run-blocking-io-oracle-gate.sh --arch x86_64` cannot currently complete a boot on x86 — it fails at this pre-existing kernel self-test before the pipe/FIFO oracle program ever runs. The x86 pipe/FIFO matrix rows for #813 PR-A are therefore recorded as implemented-but-not-boot-verified on x86, with full verification instead resting on: the x86 structural census (`pipe_fifo_blocking_structure`, `blocking_fd_eagain_structure`, both green), the x86 `boot_tests,testing,external_test_bins` regression gate (green, exercises `pipe.rs`/`handlers.rs` through the existing pipe tests), the x86 production-profile gate (green, zero warnings), and the full ARM oracle matrix (26/26 arms green across 3 boots, 5 rejected runtime mutations). aarch64 is unaffected — ARM's `boot_tests`-only profile has been exercised by other gates for a long time with no equivalent issue.

Evidence: reproduced independently on both the #813 PR-A branch tip and an unmodified checkout of `5c53ba590bbd34dc9f342a8a7bb07763608b6548` on the same host under the same build/boot procedure. Serials on request.

comments.body:
Implemented and pushed in draft PR 944: https://github.com/ryanbreen/breenix/pull/944

Baseline GDB shows the supplied-page-table fork fails on iteration 0 with the explicit non-testing refusal, not resource exhaustion. The later ownership oracle exposed the same obsolete restriction in the context helper; both are repaired without changing cohort criteria or Tier-1/Tier-2 files.

Beast boot_tests-only, full x86 boot-tests, and no-feature production gates passed with warning-free builds. Mac structure suites and reversion mutations passed. The single x86 pipe/FIFO oracle guest boot completed 26 arms with failed=0 and was reaped with status 0. Its original gate scorer falsely matched benign GDT initialization; the corrected scorer passed on the saved boot, and no second oracle guest boot is claimed.

RCA, revision mapping, original failed attempts, claim-lint records and serials are committed at 64c32710b358815a866bc23f6164c51960d38ad8:
https://github.com/ryanbreen/breenix/blob/64c32710b358815a866bc23f6164c51960d38ad8/docs/planning/green-program/process/927-2026-09-07.md

Leaving the issue open pending review and merge. The pipe/FIFO arm evidence is also relevant to issue 813.

Post-merge follow-up: PR 944 merged as 8bc23710e7a50f1b1204d7f96b522f7039815f3d; issue 927 remains closed.

RCA: obsolete testing-feature guards in fork_process_with_page_table and fork_process_with_context returned an explicit refusal under boot_tests-only before the retirement/ownership cohorts could finish construction. Removing those guards enables the ordinary CoW construction path; the observed refusal was not resource exhaustion.

The new gate is docker/qemu/run-x86-boot-tests-only.sh. Its committed beast transcript records PASS at 800b2ba159beb211655324b709c239c2dbbf7615 (serials/927/reverify/beast/reverify/boot-only.log:135 in the round document). Full x86 and production results retain their separately recorded revisions.

Round record and V-1 diagnostic-command correction: https://github.com/ryanbreen/breenix/blob/640bdf72/docs/planning/green-program/process/927-2026-09-07.md

This follow-up rechecked the saved evidence and passed 103 structure tests. Boot gates were not re-run for the documentation-only correction; no boot of a later main tip is claimed.

title: x86 boot_tests-only profile: run_x86_retire_cohort_gate pairing-fork fails (pre-existing, blocks #813 PR-A's x86 oracle boot)
